ambient: You're turned through ninety degrees of something that isn't space.
The sideways speed increases without anything moving.
A voice says a number, and you're the number.
description: The world has a seam in it and you have gone in along the seam. You're the length of it. Everything is happening sideways at a constant speed and you have been part of this arrangement for much longer than you have been alive.
name: The Seam

looks: It runs through everything, and you're what runs along it.
You have been travelling it since before you had a name for travelling.
It turns a corner that isn't a direction, and you turn with it.
objects.name: the seam

looks: Enormous and entirely uninterested, the way a machine is uninterested.
It's checking your edges. You have edges.
It has done this to many things. You aren't special and this is a relief.
objects.name: the thing turning you

weather: Weather is happening sideways, at a constant speed, somewhere off to one side of you.
